q: Sarpanch says finance advice binds like decree. Collector treats mandatory. Law?
expl: Finance advises; government acts with report logic.
why: Advisor proposes executive disposes. Binding overstates role.

q: Agency liquor shop without assembly nod citing municipal licence. SI should?
expl: Tribal law needs Sabha on excise land minerals.
why: Case spirit guards resource control. Sabha supreme.

q: Hill council must hold same three-tier polls like plains citing equality. Answer?
AP poll body defers 4 mandal polls for floods, bias alleged. SI view?
options: Independent poll power; defer valid unless mala fide
expl: Local poll body independent; calamity delay valid.
why: Autonomy with restraint. Bandobast follows calendar.

q: After 26 districts new parishad funds for water roads per village guide. Who audits?
expl: Devolved money stays public under audit.
why: Scale grew with districts. Money follows accountability.

q: Why keep poll conduct and money advice in two bodies?
expl: Split avoids bias in delimitation funds.
why: Separation secures fairness. Mix risks capture.

q: Why give Gram Sabha supremacy in agency but not plain village?
why: Agency guards identity resources. Plains use representative tiers.

q: Claim: Town functions ONLY 29 and village subjects ONLY 18. Flaw?
expl: Only absolute swap false; pair fixed.
why: Absolutes betray trap. Pair memory saves.

q: Rarest: Tiny State 5 lakh wants one tier only, no middle top. Allowed?
options: Yes may skip middle; top practical need stays
expl: Below 20L middle may go; extreme one-tier judged need-wise.
why: Exception narrow not blanket. Top need remains.

q: Link polls funds plans: delayed polls, blocked funds, no district plan. Combined?
options: Polls by election body funds advice plan by DPC MPC
expl: Each lane poll fund plan separate yet linked.
why: Synthesis keeps roles. Delay in one hits others.
